# Back matter

The marker chapter carries a mark of its own, so the index has to link within
its own page as well as across the book: [Zeta]{.index}.

A range whose two marks are both in this chapter. A chapter is one Pandoc
process, which is the scope a range pairs in, so this one pairs here and
contributes a single locator — unlike the one opened two chapters back, which
no chapter can see both ends of: the discussion of
[Chapter Range]{.index range="open"} begins here and
[Chapter Range]{.index range="close"} ends here.

::: {.qi-index-here}
:::

A second placement marker in this chapter, which a book still resolves within
the one chapter before book order is consulted: the first marker above places
the index and this one is reported as ignored, naming this chapter.

::: {.qi-index-here}
:::

A third placement marker, this one naming the second declared index. A book
builds one index, so it places that one instead and says so; it is not also
reported as a second marker for an index no marker here names.

::: {.qi-index-here index="people"}
:::
